title: Clip reveal
description: A portrait picture opens from a small circle to the full rounded frame (CSS clip-path keyframes) while it settles from a slight zoom; a gold edge draws and the words slide in beside it. No library. Give a face box for a person: the words stay outside the picture.

props.title: 2-8 words beside the picture
props.face: [x, y, w, h] of the face in 0..1 of the picture, if a person is in it
props.side: left (default) or right: where the picture goes
props.poster: still shown before a video loads
